newsitem.title: INDIA: Seven Hindus killed by gunmen in Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Seven Hindus killed by gunmen in Kashmir.

text.p: Unidentified gunmen shot dead seven Hindus at a village in Kashmir's Badgam district, police said on Saturday.
A police spokesman said the shooting took place late on Friday at Sangrampur, a village 20 km (12.5 miles) southwest of Srinagar, summer capital of India's Jammu and Kashmir state.
"They have been living here all these years. All were male," the spokesman told Reuters. "We are still investigating."
The United News of India (UNI) said the victims were forced out of their homes before being shot.
Violence against Hindus in the province, mainly Hindu India's only Moslem majority state, is usually blamed on Islamic separatists.

Thousands of minority Hindus, called Pandits in the Himalayan valley, fled Kashmir after the beginning of the rebellion in the region, where violence linked to insurgency has claimed more than 20,000 lives in the past seven years.
